    MIN(l.HCT) AS min_hct,
    MAX(l.HCT) AS max_hct,
    COUNT(*) AS readings
FROM main.Laboratory AS l

WHERE p.Admission = '-'
GROUP BY typeof(l.HCT)

arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM main.Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM main.Laboratory AS h
      WHERE h.ID = p.ID
        AND (h.HCT <= 29 OR h.HCT >= 52)
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM main.Laboratory AS r
      WHERE r.ID = p.ID
        AND r.RNP <> 'negative'
        AND CAST(r.RNP AS REAL) > 16
  )
LIMIT 1
